title: interface.v1
$comment: Reader-derived projection over two file versions reporting added/removed/signatureChanged named declarations. No log event, seq or policy_seq is appended. Spans cover whole-declaration raw UTF-8 byte ranges. Correspondence is exact identity + exact signature (D3), never similarity scoring or rename detection; identity is a matching key, not proof of rename continuity. Not served until the schema-serving PR adds interface.v1 to the allowlist.

change_seq.$comment: The `seq` of the file.changed event this projection is derived from. Stamped on the response; never part of the cache key.

language.$comment: Plain string, never an enum — the language set grows PR by PR. null exactly when there is no language module (status unsupported).

language_version.$comment: Names the pinned extractor version. null exactly when there is no language module (status unsupported).

status.$comment: ready: both sides complete/absent and comparison succeeded. incomplete: a side failed to extract, or a duplicate/ambiguous correspondence made the comparison untrustworthy. unavailable: a content blob was missing. unsupported: no language module. skipped: admission rejected, timed out, or was cancelled.

fallback_reason.$comment: Required on every non-ready status, omitted on ready: before-parse-error, after-parse-error, duplicate-declaration, ambiguous-correspondence, before-blob-missing, after-blob-missing, unsupported-language, overloaded, timeout, cancelled.

changes.$comment: Always empty unless status is ready (DA-3: a partial view emits no rows). Rows are sorted removed, then signatureChanged, then added; within a kind by the D8 ordering tuple.

state.$comment: Each side reports its own actual extraction state even when its reason lost status precedence. complete: fully extracted (may hold zero declarations). absent: the file did not exist in this version. notEvaluated: extraction was never reached (skip/cancel).

reason.$comment: Present for incomplete/unavailable states (e.g. before-parse-error, before-blob-missing).

before.$comment: null for added. Present for removed and signatureChanged.

after.$comment: null for removed. Present for added and signatureChanged.

kind.$comment: The declaration kind, e.g. function, method, constructor. A plain string, never an enum.

scope.$comment: Enclosing scopes, outermost first; empty at top level.

name.$comment: The base declared name. Overload-distinguishing detail (e.g. Swift argument labels) lives in the signature, not here.

guards.$comment: Syntactic #if guard nesting, outer to inner; empty when unguarded. Part of identity: a guard change is remove+add, not signatureChanged.

declaration.$comment: A declaration record, or null for the absent side of an added/removed row.

signature.$comment: Opaque normalized signature compared only by exact equality.

byte_start.$comment: Zero-based inclusive start byte offset of the whole declaration.

byte_end.$comment: Zero-based exclusive end byte offset; the span is [byte_start, byte_end) over raw UTF-8 bytes.
